flash_691440.description: Houthi forces renew missile and drone strikes on the Red Sea port city of Mocha, targeting Saudi-backed military assets amid mounting tensions.

flash_691442.description: Terrorist Basel Salahieh, a senior commander in Hamas's military wing, has been secretly detained in Israel for two years and is now set to face trial.

flash_691441.description:
A motorcyclist in his 20s was seriously injured after being hit by a car in Jaljulia.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Beilinson Hospital in Petah Tikva.

flash_691444.description: President Trump announces that White House staff secretary Will Scharf will take over as White House counsel on September 1, replacing David Warrington.

flash_691443.description: The chairman of the Degel HaTorah party, MK Moshe Gafni, said at an event on Sunday evening, "Unlike in the past, I am not declaring in advance that we will go with Netanyahu."

flash_691448.description: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian reportedly meets Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to discuss the military and domestic situation amid rumors regarding Khamenei's health.

flash_691447.description:
The chairman of the "Together" party, Naftali Bennett, responded to remarks made by MK Moshe Gafni, who announced that he would no longer commit in advance to automatically backing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

"Make no mistake - Gafni, Bibi, and Deri are one and the same," Bennett said. He added that "anyone who truly wants to draft haredim and support IDF soldiers knows that they must keep the architects of draft evasion, Deri and Gafni, out of the government."

flash_691446.description: A new Kan 11 News poll reveals that all newly formed political parties are falling well short of the electoral threshold. Meanwhile, the Likud party sees a modest uptick in support.

flash_691445.description:
A worker in his 40s was seriously injured after falling from a height of approximately eight meters at the Hevel Modi'in Industrial Park.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Sheba Hospital in Tel Hashomer.

flash_691454.description: Why Christians should examine our own backsliding before condemning Israel or the Jewish People.

flash_691453.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed pushes back against Trump’s social media post comparing their marriages and visions for the country.

flash_691451.description:
The Yemeni military and local authorities announced that at least seven people were killed and 30 to 35 others were wounded in a large-scale missile and drone attack launched by Houthi rebels targeting the port city of Mocha.

Earlier, the Houthis claimed responsibility for the incident, alleging the operation targeted weapons depots and Saudi military troop concentrations.

flash_691449.description: Supreme Court unanimously dismisses a petition filed by Sharren Haskel requesting permission to split from the Likud party.

flash_691459.description: Deterrence replaces normalization: Riyadh has found a way to build real security architecture - with a NATO military power and with the only nuclear state in the Muslim world - without having to declare that it is actually abandoning Washington's normalization track.

flash_691458.description: Does Arab Palestinianism mean anything more than “Death to Israel!"? It does not seem so, meaning that Israeli sovereignty is the only practical solution.

flash_691456.description: Before you chase dividends, crypto, or hot stocks, make sure your money has a clear purpose.

flash_691452.description: Hezbollah-affiliated Lebanese network report indicates no Israel-Lebanon talks are scheduled for next month, following disagreements over pilot zones and border security.

flash_691450.description: Iran appoints former Revolutionary Guards commander Mohsen Rezaei as secretary of the Supreme National Security Council following Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr's resignation.

flash_691465.description: Lebanese media say Israel used latest round of negotiations to press for answers on Ron Arad and other Jews missing since Lebanon's civil war.

flash_691464.description:
Israel Railways has begun conducting passenger-free test runs on the Karmiel-Ahihud line using the ETCS control and signaling system, following the launch of the pilot in the Jerusalem area, Modi'in, and along the Ayalon corridor.

According to Israel Railways, the system is designed to enable an increase in train frequency using the existing rail infrastructure, while improving safety and the management of train traffic.

flash_691462.description: Aliza Bloch officially joins new political party founded by former ministers Gilad Erdan and Yuli Edelstein, after reportedly turning down reserved spot on Likud list.

flash_691460.description: Scorching conditions continue across Israel, with Jordan Valley expected to reach 44°C as forecasters warn of heavy to extreme heat stress.

flash_691457.description: Officials in a Middle Eastern country advised officials in another country to show flexibility, sign an agreement with Israel - and violate it if a large-scale military conflict breaks out. Is Israel once again falling victim to a “conception"?

flash_691455.description: Dedi Simhi, tapped as the No. 2 candidate on Benny Gantz's slate, is reconsidering his political future and considering a jump to Likud if offered a guaranteed spot on their roster.

flash_691468.description: Prof. Mitch Schwaber says he asked a senior BBC correspondent how the network would ensure accuracy in a report on Gaza's health situation after citing six examples of what he described as errors and journalistic negligence.

flash_691467.description: Tehran says Washington must end its military pressure and compensate Iran before the crucial shipping lane can be considered open again.

flash_691466.description: Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth decided, contrary to the Defense Minister’s request, to renew the administrative detention order against Tal Yinon Dardik, who is suspected of assaulting a Palestinian.

flash_691463.description: A new study paints a troubling picture of the Jordanian border, urging Israel to strengthen ties with Jordan, accelerate construction of border and reinforce Jordan Valley communities.

flash_691461.description: The jurisdiction of Givat Harel (Carmei Oz) over declared state lands has been officially approved, with Kida and Esh Kodesh receiving official recognition. Israel Ganz: 'A major step toward growth in Binyamin.'

flash_691472.description: 25 years ago, my daughter was killed in the Sbarro bombing. Why is her killer still free?

flash_691471.description: Avida Bachar, who lost his wife and son on October 7, says Israel must reject any deal that leaves Hamas in control of Gaza and show determination to prevent another massacre.

flash_691469.description: Sanzer Rebbe meet young haredi recently freed from military prison, praises his steadfastness, insisting 'most Jews in Israel' do not hate Torah students.

flash_691479.description: Senior officials behind US President Donald Trump's Gaza initiative say Israel's actions on the ground align with the 15-point proposal, despite Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's public rejection of it.

flash_691478.description: Pro-Israel Democratic Senator responds to radical Michigan Senate nominee who called to put his head 'on a pike.'

flash_691476.description: We must protect our communities from online messages intended to weaken faith, normalize transgression, and influence others-particularly the young and vulnerable-to reject the sacred foundations of Jewish life.

flash_691475.description: New Civil Administration data show record 536 illegal Arab structures demolished in just six months, as Israel steps up enforcement in Area C.

flash_691474.description: Strong winds driving fast-moving wildfire toward farm in Gush Etzion, firefighting aircraft and ground crews battle to halt advance.

flash_691473.description: William Shakin, a volunteer in the Golani Brigade who fought in Gaza, took his own life in New York after his mental health deteriorated. His parents seek to have him buried in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl.

flash_691470.description: Customers paid a fraction of their electricity debts to have them illegally wiped from Israel Electric Corporation records, police say.

flash_691483.description: At least two people have died and 20 buildings have collapsed in a powerful earthquake in the country of Colombia. Many people remain trapped under the debris.

flash_691482.description: Twenty years after Major Roi Klein fell in Bint Jbeil, his eldest son Gilad enlisted in his father's Golani 51st Battalion alongside his brother.

flash_691480.description: Safed historian Yaakov Schenkman discovered an Irgun heritage site vandalized, with its Israeli flag torn down, gate ripped out and trash strewn inside.

flash_691477.description: Both Turkey and Qatar are strong supporters of the Muslim Brotherhood and collaborate to finance the construction of mosques in Europe.

flash_691486.description: Beit Jann's Yalla Ba'Galil festival, featuring Jewish and Druze artists, was canceled over fears of clashes, with reports saying Eden Ben-Zaken's planned performance sparked the dispute.

flash_691485.description: Einav Zangauker claims that during a meeting with Yair Golan in February, she was offered a reserved spot near the top of the Democrats’ Knesset slate and that the agreement was subsequently reaffirmed.

flash_691481.description: In announcing AI program, PM Netanyahu says: “The future is not waiting for us; we are creating it."

flash_691495.description: Trump rejects Iran's compensation demands and orders US negotiators to seek payments for Americans killed or wounded in conflicts with Tehran.

flash_691494.description: Colombian authorities report that at least 77 people have been killed in the 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck the country.

flash_691492.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir presented CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper with a shofar, praising the unprecedented strategic partnership between the militaries.

flash_691490.description: Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett arrived at the IDF induction center to accompany new recruits joining the Golani Brigade and the Egoz Unit.

flash_691484.description: An eastern Jerusalem man known as 'Tarzan' was indicted after allegedly impersonating a rival to send death threats and weapon images to Ben-Gvir and Sukkot.

flash_691499.description: A Channel 14 News poll gives the right-wing bloc some good news.

flash_691498.description: Satmar Grand Rebbe Rabbi Zalman Leib Teitelbaum condemned efforts to brand Zohran Mamdani an antisemite, warning they could provoke hostility.

flash_691496.description: Trump rejects Iran's compensation demands and says Iran should "be responsible for the damages and death caused to the people of Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, and Gaza!"

flash_691493.description: Post-Tu b’Av Full Moon, a Special Shabbat Night, and the Rebbe’s Remarks in His Last Public Address.

flash_691491.description: IDF Chief of Staff Zamir: We are at a strategic crossroads, prepared to return to high-intensity combat.’

flash_691489.description:
Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar commended Colombia's decision to recognize Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights, calling it "historic," and thanking President De La Espriella and Minister of Foreign Affairs Omar Bula Escobar.

Sa'ar noted that the decision follows his meeting with the President in Barranquilla, Colombia, last Thursday.

"With this, the President of Colombia has demonstrated, in one of his first decisions in office, his leadership, his values, and his commitment to Israel and Israel's security," Sa'ar stated.

"Israel is a small country without strategic depth. Having defensible borders is essential for Israel in order to guarantee the existence of the Jewish people in its historic homeland," he added.

The Israeli Foreign Minister pledged to "continue to act so that more countries join the United States (under President Trump) and Colombia (under President De La Espriella) in recognizing Israel's sovereignty over the Golan, to which Israeli law was applied 45 years ago."

flash_691487.description: It is forbidden to harm Arabs or their property in order to deter them from harming Jews, or to expel them. It is forbidden for any person to break the law and take the law into his own hands.

flash_691502.description: Haredi leader Rabbi Dov Landau condemns what he calls persecution of Torah study, urging yeshiva students to deepen their learning amid new decrees.

flash_691501.description: About 30 female commanders and recruits at the Sde Boker Gadna base have been suffering from vomiting, diarrhea and abdominal pain in recent days.

flash_691500.description: Oren Dobronsky apologized to Trump after past posts criticizing his Iran war policy surfaced shortly after Netanyahu named him to a Likud slot.

flash_691497.description: The Shin Bet rejected a report claiming that agency chief David Zini removed an official following criticism of a letter written by his wife.

flash_691503.description: The IAEA will extract nuclear material from a secret Syrian site following a US-brokered deal with Damascus and Israel to avert a regional escalation, reports Axios.

flash_691506.description: Rezaei was the first commander of the IRGC Intelligence Unit and later, in 1980, was appointed by Khomeini to command the IRGC itself. Opinion.

flash_691505.description: There seems to be a generation gap in awareness and action. Time to focus on those who come out to rallies and want to make their voices heard. Opinion.

flash_691504.description: President Trump warns that military options remain open, rejects Iran's reparations demands, and declares US Navy control over the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691508.description: Police charge a third suspect in March synagogue shootings in Toronto and Vaughan, resolving outstanding suspects as community leaders urge probe of foreign ties.

flash_691507.description: The IDF carried out a strike on Monday evening in the southern Lebanese village of Al-Mansouri, located within the Israeli security zone.

flash_691510.description: Likud announces that its secretariat will be asked to approve guaranteed spots on its KNesset slate for Foreign Minister Sa'ar, Defense Minister Katz, and Central Committee chairman Haim Katz.

flash_691509.description:
Libya's National Oil Corporation (NOC) announced that an unmanned aerial vehicle crashed near a primary oil storage tank and pipeline network at the Azzawiya refinery mixing facility. This marks the third such attack targeting the facility in just two days.

The corporation noted that no structural damage occurred and no casualties were reported. However, the company warned that if attacks on energy infrastructure persist, it will be forced to declare force majeure and initiate a total shutdown of the refinery's operations.

flash_691514.description: The defense establishment has identified an acceleration in the rebuilding of the Syrian Air Force, roughly a year and eight months after the IDF declared its destruction.

flash_691513.description:
A man in his 30s was seriously injured in a violent incident in Tayibe.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him while conscious to Meir Hospital.

flash_691511.description:
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported that the Ukrainian capital came under attack from Russian ballistic missiles.

A series of loud explosions echoed across the city overnight, with the Ukrainian Air Force activating air defense systems to intercept the incoming threats. Klitschko urged residents to remain in shelters and protected areas until the air raid alerts are lifted.

flash_691521.description: Iran rejects new US sanctions targeting its shadow banking network, warning Washington's pressure campaign undermines potential diplomatic solutions.

flash_691520.description:
Overnight, three Israeli civilians arrived at the Mount Hermon area and crossed the border into Syrian territory. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area to locate them and returned them to Israeli territory, said the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, which added that the detained civilians were transferred to the Israel Police for further handling.

"The IDF strongly condemns such incidents, which constitute an additional incident that disturbs the soldiers’ operational activity in the area and puts them in danger.The law enforcement authorities are required to bring those involved to justice and to prevent those individuals from repeatedly engaging in this incident, which constitutes a criminal offense," said the statement.

flash_691518.description: Abdul El-Sayed condemns Hamas for war crimes while continue to criticize Israel and claim it committed genocide.

flash_691516.description: Houthi rebels fire ballistic missiles at Mocha for a second straight day, targeting Saudi troops and arms depots with drones and projectiles.

flash_691512.description: Following an Axios report detailing understandings reached between Israel, Syria, and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) to neutralize a covert nuclear site, the Syrian Atomic Energy Commission issued an official statement confirming the move. The statement emphasized that "Syria continues to cooperate transparently and closely with the IAEA, the United States, and friendly nations to address and dismantle the legacy covert nuclear program of the previous regime."

flash_691524.description: A debate between Yoseph Haddad and anti-Israel activists turned physical after a Groyper YouTuber allegedly attacked him in a studio and parking lot.

flash_691523.description: The surest sign of the revealed End of the Exile is when the Land of Israel gives forth her fruits in abundance, something which our generation has merited to witness. Medinat Yisrael is the greatest miracle that has transpired in the world since the beginning of Creation.

flash_691519.description: Palestinian Arab culture has all the fanatical monomania of Rome's quest to destroy Carthage, but none of Rome's contributions to humanity, all of the anger and vengeance but none of the beauty and truth.

flash_691517.description: The Mossad just reassigned the men who promised to topple Tehran. The mission stands; the instrument was wrong.

flash_691515.description: The Washington Post reveals: US officials used a decoy Air Force One and a catering truck to secretly move Donald Trump onto a military jet in Turkey following an Iranian assassination threat.

flash_691529.description: Not voting is, effectively, a vote in favor of the noxious socialist program. Opinion.

flash_691528.description: The Ministry of Health says a traveler returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo developed a fever and is being treated in isolation at Soroka Hospital as testing and an epidemiological investigation get underway.

flash_691526.description: Major Jewish rabbinical groups say they were excluded from Mamdani's meeting with rabbis, amid concerns over Israel, antisemitism and his rhetoric.

flash_691525.description: Ten rabbis from all stripes of American Judaism reportedly confronted New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani over his anti-Israel statements.

flash_691522.description: PA soccer chief Jibril Rajoub announces the September return of Palestinian Arab soccer leagues while demanding FIFA penalize and isolate Israeli teams.

flash_691535.description:
Following the violent assault last night (Monday) in Los Angeles, Israeli advocacy activist Yoseph Haddad filed an official police complaint against the attacker, Dennis Feitosa.

Feitosa, a far-right activist, lost his temper during the recording of a podcast, cursed at Haddad, and attempted to attack him in the studio. He later ambushed Haddad in a parking lot and attacked him from behind.

Haddad, a former Golani Brigade soldier, pushed back against and subdued the attacker. The matter is now also being handled as a criminal case by local law enforcement authorities in the United States.

flash_691534.description: The Shimon Battalion completed its first battalion-level exercise in the Golan Heights, marking the completion of its formation ahead of operational missions in the north.

flash_691532.description: Lachish Central Unit detectives, Border Police National Guardsmen, and police officers raid dozens of homes in Ashdod, Kiryat Gat, and other locations in fight against protection rackets.

flash_691530.description: Families of October 7 victims said the IDF inquiry revealed horrific details of the Re'im shelter massacre and questioned why only three of the 100 terrorists were eliminated since then.

flash_691527.description:
Israel’s Health Ministry said it received an initial report concerning a person suspected of having Ebola after returning several days ago from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and developing a fever.

The individual is being treated in isolation at Soroka Medical Center, while an epidemiological investigation is underway. The ministry stressed that this is only a suspected case at this stage and that test results are expected within the next 24 hours.

flash_691544.description: UKMTO has been informed of an incident off the coast of Al Mokha, Yemen. It has been reported that a cargo vessel in the Southern Red Sea has been hit by an unknown projectile, resulting in casualties. Authorities are investigating.

flash_691543.description: While searching a home in the Hebron area, forces find a carbine rifle, two magazines, and two bags of assorted ammunition hidden behind a wall.

flash_691541.description: A Syrian court has sentenced ousted president Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia after convicting him of war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

flash_691539.description: The Israeli Embassy in Vienna is appealing for assistance in locating Mali and Liel Yahalomi, who were last seen in the city on Friday, August 7th.

flash_691537.description: Israeli-Arab advocacy activist Yoseph Haddad submits a complaint against Dennis Feitosa after the latter allegedly assaulted him during a debate.

flash_691533.description: Lebanese reports of a drone strike on a vehicle in Nabatieh

flash_691531.description: Border Police arrested two suspects after allegedly catching them loading more than 1,000 kilograms of watermelons into a vehicle at an agricultural plot near Ein HaMifratz.

flash_691547.description:
A short while ago, IDF troops identified a sniper from the Hamas terrorist organization who posed an immediate threat near the Yellow Line area, where IDF troops are operating in the northern Gaza Strip.

Shortly after the identification, IDF troops fired toward the terrorist in order to remove the threat. A hit was identified.

flash_691546.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu approves seniority waivers allowing four candidates to run in the Likud primaries, denies same exemption to Hadar Muchtar.

flash_691545.description: Former Mossad chief Yossi Cohen reveals operatives repeatedly visited Iran’s heavily fortified Fordow facility, calling the U.S. strike on the site 'the fulfillment of all my dreams.'

flash_691542.description:
Gilad Erdan said that one of the fundamental conditions for forming a “broad Zionist government" would be the immediate establishment of an independent commission of inquiry into the events of October 7 that, he said, would have the public’s trust.

Erdan said he opposes both a commission appointed solely by the head of the judicial system and a political commission appointed by politicians. According to Erdan, the commission’s composition should allow for an objective and professional investigation of all those involved in the failures that led to the massacre, including the political leadership, security establishment, and judicial system.

flash_691540.description: The brother of Golani Sgt. Amichay Rubin, who fell fighting on Oct. 7, enlisted in the brigade, carrying on his brother's legacy despite the pain.

flash_691538.description: Security forces demolished the home of the terrorist responsible for the deadly attack near a village in Samaria, less than three weeks after the shooting that killed Yuval Ezra and Binyahu Mellet.

flash_691536.description: Former Hamas hostage Sagui Dekel-Chen performed nine songs he composed during 498 days in captivity, returning to the Nir Oz lawn where he grew up.

flash_691554.description: New Defense Ministry contract to fund development of low-cost autonomous strike drones intended for widespread deployment across IDF frontline units.

flash_691553.description: Sky News Arabia reports that talks between Israel and Lebanon in Rome will resume in early September. Until then, interim talks will be held in Washington, Beirut, and Jerusalem.

flash_691552.description: The death toll from the earthquake has risen to 224, while more than 2,700 people remain missing. Thousands of homes have been damaged or destroyed.

flash_691551.description: The organization “Haredim in the Army - Preserving Identity" assists \haredi soldiers who discover the complexities of life within the military framework, and it turns out there are quite a few challenges.

flash_691550.description: MK Hili Tropper says Israel needs a broad Zionist government that rises above political camps, adding that Itamar Ben Gvir could be part of it if he meets additional conditions.

flash_691549.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee and Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana visited Macmull Guitars in Ma'ale Adumim.

Huckabee wrote on X: "Speaker of the Israeli Knesset Amir Ohana (a virtuoso guitarist!) & I toured the incredible custom guitar maker Macmull Guitars in Ma'ale Adumim just outside of Jerusalem. Amazing hand-made guitars by genuine craftsmen. Of course we jammed a bit!"

flash_691548.description: Be’eri resident and former head of the Eshkol Regional Council Haim Yellin warns about the plan for Gaza: Even with only a small portion of the territory, Hamas is capable of recreating October 7.

flash_691557.description: Following the detection of the aircraft, flights were temporarily halted.

flash_691556.description: Entry of multinational force, Green Rafah initiative, and technocratic government face delays leaving postwar plan far from implementation.

flash_691555.description: After 38 days in detention, the court has decided to release Tal Yinon Dardik, who is suspected of abusing a Palestinian Arab, without any restrictive conditions.

flash_691562.description: Homes belonging to Jewish families collapsed and a synagogue was damaged.

flash_691561.description: Violating ceasefire, Hamas sniper targets IDF troops, forcing response and highlighting danger in IDF withdrawal.

flash_691559.description: A British government survey reveals troubling findings: Jewish school principals are devoting more time to security arrangements than to educational matters.

flash_691558.description: Five days after Israeli mother and daughter vanish during trip to Europe, local Chabad emissary says there is still 'not a single lead' despite an intensive search.

flash_691567.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir slams Likud election slogan, warning government with Yashar! chair Gadi Eisenkot would 'bury the judicial reform,' grant victory to Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara.

flash_691566.description: Soldiers reported that terrorists appeared to be preparing to cross the border and requested authorization to strike, but commanders refused.

flash_691564.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich calls on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to bar Palestinian Authority Chairman Mahmoud Abbas from returning to Judea and Samaria following visit abroad. 'Palestinian Terrorist Authority must be dismantled.'

flash_691573.description: US Navy helicopter fires Hellfire missiles at a Panama-flagged cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman after its crew ignores warnings and attempts to enter Iran.

flash_691572.description: Democrats chairman praises the Ra'am leader MK Mansour Abbas, says it is 'clear' his party will receive more significant portfolios.

flash_691571.description: I came to Iceland loving one of the most beautiful countries on earth. I leave after repeated harassment, two physical assaults and moments when I feared for my life as a Jew. Op-ed.

flash_691569.description: At his 4-year-old grandson's funeral, Rabbi Arush said haredi students do not have a 'vacation from the Torah' during the yeshiva's vacations.

flash_691565.description:
The IDF claimed that Israeli civilians attempted yesterday (Monday) to enter the area of ​​the village of Qusra, which is under a closed military zone order, by using an ambulance.

"Upon the ambulance’s arrival at the checkpoint, IDF soldiers identified Israeli civilians inside who attempted to enter the area subject to the closed military zone order under the ambulance’s cover. As a result, the IDF soldiers operating at the checkpoint conducted an inspection of the ambulance. Subsequently, the ambulance was inspected by the Israel Police," the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

flash_691563.description: Report of explosions in Sirik, southern Iran

flash_691574.description: Despite recently allocated funding, the Military Advocate General's Corps has yet to fill the positions required to try hundreds of terrorists who participated in the October 7 massacre.

flash_691570.description: OU leader Rabbi Dr. Josh Joseph says soaring antisemitism has triggered an unexpected Jewish awakening, with thousands of teenagers searching for identity, pride and connection.

flash_691568.description: The nightmare scenario is not necessarily that the Mecca agreement immediately becomes an Islamic NATO. The nightmare is that it gradually becomes one. Opinion.

flash_691560.description: In first since 2009, Israel and Venezuela announce new cooperation, establish mechanism to provide consular services to citizens.

flash_691577.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was mistakenly launched toward a target that was later identified as IDF fire from operations conducted within the Security Zone in southern Lebanon. No injuries were reported, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.

The incident is under review. No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_691576.description: Houthi ballistic missile strike on a commercial vessel in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait kills six people, marking the first fatalities of this maritime conflict.

flash_691575.description:
The Likud party is denying a report broadcast Tuesday evening on Channel 12 News claiming that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu granted entrepreneur Oren Dobronsky a reserved spot on the election slate in order to undercut the political standing of Minister Nir Barkat.

"The Prime Minister granted a reserved spot to Oren Dobronsky because he is a successful high-tech entrepreneur, philanthropist, and leading businessman who will bring his rich experience to developing Israel's economy, with a emphasis on the tech sector and advancing artificial intelligence in Israel," Likud said in a statement.

flash_691578.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador defends Jewish presence in Judea and Samaria at the Security Council, calling out anti-Israel bias over “settler violence".

flash_691583.description: President Trump rejects assertions he trusts Iran, claims total US control of Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691582.description: Appointed Sen. Darline Graham advances to South Carolina's GOP primary runoff for her late brother’s seat.

flash_691580.description: North Korea fires a ballistic missile off its eastern coast as Washington and Seoul prepare for major joint military drills later this month.

flash_691579.description:
Hapoel Be'er Sheva recorded a victory on Tuesday evening against Red Star Belgrade, bringing the team within just two matches of qualifying for the Champions League group stage.

Shino Zuares, Chairman of the Israel Soccer Association, praised the club's personnel and fans, stating: "A wonderful victory for Hapoel Be'er Sheva, which is now just one round away from a historic qualification for the club and a deeply significant moment for our soccer in the Champions League. Kudos to the professional staff, owner Alona Barkat, the players, and the fans who accompanied and cheered on this fantastic team in Serbia as well. We will continue to offer our support and keep our fingers crossed."

flash_691588.description: Human Rights Watch and several others file federal lawsuit challenging Trump administration sanctions on the ICC, alleging the measures violate constitutional rights.

flash_691587.description: French Jewish tourist attacked twice in central Rome over two days, leading Italian police to arrest a suspect on hate crime charges.

flash_691585.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu thanks Colombia for recognizing Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights, declaring the plateau will remain Israeli land.

flash_691581.description:
Two men in their 40s were killed in a two-vehicle collision on Route 383, south of Beit Shemesh.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics pronounced the men dead at the scene and evacuated a woman in her 40s to Shaare Zedek Hospital in Jerusalem in moderate condition. Police have opened an investigation into the crash, and the road has been closed to traffic.

flash_691593.description: Negotiations with regimes and terrorist organizations are not normal business negotiations. You cannot assume that because someone agreed to or even signed something yesterday, they will honor it tomorrow. Op-ed.

flash_691592.description: The question of what will happen at Ali al-Taher “the day after" is not a tactical question concerning one more ridge or a few more kilometers inside Lebanon. It is a strategic question. Opinion.

flash_691590.description: Weeks before the new school year, proposed budget cuts could force schools to reduce resources and staffing for small and special education classes.

flash_691586.description: Iran’s new national security chief Mohsen Rezaei states the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Washington meets Tehran’s demands and ends regional hostilities.

flash_691584.description: US official praises recent Israel-Lebanon talks in Rome as constructive, finalizing pilot zone rules to verify Hezbollah disarmament despite friction.
